summary: 2026-09-17 (cont.): Root-caused the real TotalTrades=0 bug in Orb.cs (task t-b2d143): NT8 log showed 'An Enter() method... has been ignored... Internal Order Handling Rules that Reduce Unwanted Positions' fired for BOTH the long and short stop-entry orders every single day - NT8's Managed order approach silently blocks submitting two opposing entry orders (our OCO straddle) while flat, which is exactly the ORB entry pattern. Confirmed via a 5-month test4 run (still 0 trades) and by screenshotting NT8's actual NinjaScript Output panel (UI Automation couldn't read its text via accessible/TextPattern - it's a custom-rendered editor control - so had to screenshot + visually read it). Rewrote Orb.cs's order handling to NT8's documented fix: Unmanaged approach (IsUnmanaged=true, SubmitOrderUnmanaged with OCO ids linking the two entries, then linking stop+target as a second OCO pair on fill, manual flatten via SubmitOrderUnmanaged market orders instead of ExitLong/ExitShort). Also built a real fix for the user's 'why can't you recompile for me' complaint: proved out Windows UI Automation (PowerShell, EnumWindows/SetForegroundWindow/SendKeys F5) can drive NT8's NinjaScript Editor - focus the already-open editor window and send F5 - which DOES trigger a real recompile without any manual click, IF the target file's editor tab doesn't have stale unsaved content. Discovered a second real gotcha this way: NinjaScript Editor tabs left open across sessions do NOT auto-reload when a file changes on disk (via our deploy.ps1 copy) - the tab silently keeps stale in-memory content and F5 recompiles THAT, not the new file on disk. Confirmed via a 'Close Tab - unsaved changes will be lost' dialog appearing when trying to close the Orb.cs tab right after deploying new code nobody had typed into that tab. Fix: close (discard) + reopen the tab from the NinjaScript Explorer tree before F5, which forces a fresh read from disk - verified this combination actually compiles new code by round-tripping a unique Print marker. After that fix, ran test6.job (Orb/ES_1M_2024/2024-01-01..01-08) and it hung: job moved to jobs/done/ but NO result.txt was ever written (not even the BacktestRunner's own 'ERROR\n'+exception fallback, which should always fire per its try/catch/finally in ProcessJobSafe) - strong signal of a crash NT8 swallows internally rather than a normal .NET exception. Root-caused: SetDefaults still had EntriesPerDirection=1 and EntryHandling=AllEntries set alongside the new IsUnmanaged=true - both are Managed-approach-only properties, invalid in combination with Unmanaged and likely throwing during property-set on NT8's internal thread (explaining why RunBacktest() never returns normally OR throws back to our catch). Removed both lines, redeployed - did NOT get to recompile+retest before hitting this session's context limit.
